On every studio/packaging shot (slots 1,2,3,10) the jewelry is the SINGLE tack-sharp hero and sole focal point; the printed Lucent Carat Lab logo must stay the EXACT preserved logo - identical design, colours, two-tone typography and the FUTURE OF FINE JEWELRY tagline, never altered/recoloured/miswritten/single-line-sans-serif - but rendered SOFT and OUT OF FOCUS in the shallow macro depth of field, dimmer and clearly less sharp than the ring, never competing. Where the logo falls near the ring it is blurred by the DoF so the ring alone stays the focal point. The logo is understated by FOCUS and BRIGHTNESS only, NEVER by changing its design/colour/typography/tagline. Lifestyle/close-up/macro shots carry no logo. Applies to all future catalogs.

TRADE-OFF (accepted by the user 2026-07-20): for a worn lifestyle/close-up angle the source cannot cover faithfully, composite-v1 SKIPS the shot or requests more source rather than let AI redraw the ring - missing is preferable to incorrect (docs/15 §5, hybrid-composite-default). fixes.fix: LOGO PHYSICAL PRINT RULE (CRITICAL, every studio prompt): the logo is REAL GOLD INK PRINTED DIRECTLY onto the cloth - never redraw/regenerate/repaint/restyle/vectorize/recreate it, and never place ANY shadow, glow, white patch, blur, gradient, halo, emboss effect, lighting effect, reflection, drop shadow, or artificial background/masking beneath or around it. Only the gold ink itself should be visible - the cloth texture continues naturally underneath with no visible masking/background layer, and the logo casts no shadow of its own. The logo must inherit the cloth's texture (weave visible through the ink), folds (ink bends/distorts over folds), perspective, lighting direction and shadows, and surface imperfections - same lighting calibration as the rest of the cloth, not evenly bright regardless of scene light. BLOCKING VALIDATION: if any shadow, glow, white background, masking, halo, or AI-generated separation-effect appears around the logo, the render is INVALID - discard and regenerate.

fixes.problem: the ring is not instantly the focal point: eye is pulled to cloth/props/flowers/books/furniture/hands/scenery; background too busy or sharper than the ring; ring framed small with large empty negative space; wide environmental or portrait-style hand shots where the hand is the subject; OR (2026-07-15) ring placed off-center/near an edge instead of centered

FORBIDDEN: busy backgrounds, distracting props, strong competing textures, large empty negative space, wide environmental shots, portrait framing with the hand as subject, background sharper than the ring, off-center/edge-placed jewelry, any composition where the jewelry is not instantly the focal point. Every shot must read as luxury jewelry product photography; if the eye goes anywhere but the ring first, the ring isn't centered, or the background competes/out-sharpens it -> regenerate.

Bright neutral-white daylight and byte-identical ring geometry are unchanged — this varies only camera craft, never centering/composition-balance. If a shot looks artificial/rendered → regenerate with a more natural camera and focal plane, keeping the ring centered.

fixes.problem: studio logo either (a) missing because the shot was left on clean cloth, or (b) present but looking like a flat vector sticker floating on the cloth - ignoring folds, razor-crisp, no weave showing through, own lighting, no embed. INVALID.

FORBIDDEN (any one = reject): background plate, white patch, shadow behind logo, glow, outline, opacity tricks, compositing/watermark appearance, post-production-placement look. REQUIRED: follows the cloth weave; warps with every fold; stretches with the fabric; receives IDENTICAL lighting as the cloth (no independent brightness); loses sharpness with camera focus/DoF (never sharper than the cloth); partly hidden by folds/highlights/valleys where applicable; ink slightly sinks into the fibres like real metallic fabric printing. If the logo looks digitally placed, REJECT the image and regenerate in-scene or fall back to scripts/print_logo_on_cloth.py. Never ship an overlay-looking logo.
fixes.fix: PRIMARY (mandated): generate the studio shot WITH the logo IN-SCENE. Feed the model both the official logo artwork (assets/logo/logo_official.png -> media) AND a branded-cloth reference, and instruct: reproduce the EXACT logo as premium metallic GOLD HOT-FOIL STAMPING printed into the white fabric beneath the ring. The foil MUST: follow every cloth fold/wrinkle/curve; let the fabric weave stay visible through it; inherit the cloth's exact lighting/shadows/highlights; stay sharp, centered, fully visible, at the SAME SCALE as the reference; preserve the exact design/proportions/spacing/typography (LUCENT CARAT LAB / FUTURE OF FINE JEWELRY). It must NOT float, overlay, emboss, engrave, sit on a separate layer, or look like a digital graphic - it looks permanently printed into the cloth. VERIFY every render vs the official artwork; if the logo typography/design is wrong, or it floats/embosses, REJECT and regenerate - do NOT remove or ship it altered. Missing logo = INVALID. FALLBACK (only if in-model cannot reproduce the exact logo after retries): composite the locked logo locally via scripts/print_logo_on_cloth.py (0 credits, pixel-exact; enforces fold displacement, soft edges, weave-through, darken-only edge absorption, brightness-clamped matched lighting, ink-diffusion grain, flat hot-foil finish). Either path must end with the exact logo permanently printed into the fabric.

JEWELRY = LOCKED READ-ONLY ASSET, same protection as the P0 logo/watermark: AI owns the scene only; the source owns 100% of the jewelry; it is NOT an AI generation target. ONLY whole-asset non-destructive ops allowed: preserve, position, scale uniformly, rotate as a whole, perspective-transform as a whole - NEVER rebuild/rasterize/redraw/repaint/inpaint/diffuse/re-render/regenerate at the pixel level. If a processing step would modify the jewelry, SKIP it or fail safely - never alter. Priority: (1) preserve jewelry exactly (highest); (2) generate environment; (3) blend without changing any jewelry pixel. FAIL-CLOSED: if the jewelry cannot be preserved exactly (e.g. an angle the source cannot supply), STOP - report the angle cannot be produced, request more source (CAD angle / 3D model), never invent; failure is preferred over reconstruction. Any modification = rejected automatically. Founding principle of composite-v1 (ring = source pixels -> guaranteed by construction); legacy must pass the difference detector (docs/16) or fail. Umbrella over geometry-immutable-auto-fallback, zero-jewelry-invention, and the head/gallery lock.

Every output must pass automatic geometry QC before delivery. fixes.problem: a composite preserved geometry perfectly (ring = source pixels) but was still a FAILED image: composited onto a scene that already had a ring (double ring / original halo peeking behind the inserted solitaire), with the source drop-shadow left un-keyed as a white mask/segmentation-residue patch, and mismatched contact lighting. qc_final false-PASSED it on geometry provenance alone.

fixes.fix: COMPOSITE INTEGRITY (user-locked 2026-07-16, docs/16). Checks (reject if any fail): original_object_removed, single_ring_present, no_segmentation_artifacts, no_white_mask_residue, consistent_lighting_shadows, natural_background_integration. Guarantee at the INPUT: composite ONLY into a clean ring-free scene (empty cloth / bare finger) and key the source with a clean alpha (drop its shadow). qc.composite_integrity HARD-FAILS original_object_removed + single_ring_present unless caller asserts scene_is_clean=True; segmentation/residue/lighting/integration are vision/manual 'unverified' (classical CV can't reliably detect a soft white-mask patch - reads like cloth highlights; no pixel-detector claimed). qc_final no longer auto-passes a composite on geometry alone: stays geometry_guaranteed but passed=False until integrity satisfied. Geometry regression suite asserts geometry_guaranteed only; integrity checked per-shot/shadow-test.

fixes.problem: dozens of overlapping token/preview/commit/reasoning rules force reasoning about which wins, causing conflicts.

Observed failure: raw render added a thick circular support ring below the center stone + reshaped the gallery + thicker head + more metal volume (source had a plain open basket). Never add a support ring/girdle rail/gallery rail/metal collar/extra bridge/thicker head/any structural metal absent from source; if metal appears that is not in the source, fail QC automatically. Composite render (composite-v1) = invention IMPOSSIBLE (ring is source pixels), auto-pass - the reliable fix. fixes.problem: a new pipeline could silently replace the working one, a rollback could lose validated learning, or an unproven change could become default before proving equal-or-better.
fixes.root_cause: no versioned pipelines, no one-value switch, no shadow-test gate, and learning tied to pipeline implementation.
fixes.fix: SAFE PIPELINE VERSIONING + ZERO-LOSS LEARNING (user-locked 2026-07-16, docs/15). (1) PRESERVE: git tag pipeline-stable marks last proven commit; config/pipeline_versions.json snapshots each version's prompt/provider/QC/geometry/compositing profile; legacy stays runnable, never deleted. (2) VERSIONED: legacy (stable default, prompt-based) + composite-v1 (experimental, geometry guaranteed by compositing real source pixels); select via ONE value (env PIPELINE_MODE overrides registry active) - resolver lib/pipeline/mode.py; no source edits. (3) ROLLBACK: scripts/rollback-pipeline.ps1|.sh <mode> restores that version's profile + verifies imports. (4) SHADOW TEST before replacement (dispatch.shadow_test, POST /shadow-test): geometry categories auto-decided (composite guaranteed vs legacy unverified), scene categories = needs_human; promote composite-v1 to stable ONLY when equal-or-better in EVERY critical fidelity category. (5) AUTO-FALLBACK (dispatch.generate, POST /generate): run selected pipeline -> QC -> on failure fall back once (single hop) to the version's fallback_to. Bidirectional: legacy->composite-v1 (raw render failing geometry gate is rescued by compositing the real ring) and composite-v1->legacy (if composite cannot produce a valid image, fall back to the STABLE pipeline; that legacy render is geometry-unverified so it routes to the human approval gate, never auto-shipped). Record which pipeline delivered; never deliver below the approved baseline. (6) LEARNING separate from code: QUALITY_MEMORY.json = validated shared store (both pipelines read); config/learning_candidates.json = candidate store; rolling back code never deletes validated learning. (7) PROMOTION: candidate -> validated only after it improves output or user approves; a bad candidate is disabled WITH failure evidence, never deleted. (8) APPROVED BASELINE per SKU in config/deliveries/LR-XXXX.json (source, approved first image, pipeline version, prompt hash, provider/model/seed, geometry+camera/lighting/cloth/logo profiles, corrections, QC report); never deliver below it. (9) GIT SAFETY: main stays stable; risky work isolated by the PIPELINE_MODE flag + versioned modules (not branches); before promotion commit+tag+regression+test-rollback+verify-both+push. (10) improvements reversible, validated learning permanent, failed experiments recorded not repeated, stable pipeline always available.
